title: Can AI Agents Answer Your Data Questions? A Benchmark for Data Agents
authors_zh: Ruiying Ma, Shreya Shankar, Ruiqi Chen, Yiming Lin, Sepanta Zeighami, Rajoshi Ghosh, Abhinav Gupta, Anushrut Gupta, Tanmai Gopal, Aditya G. Parameswaran
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** Fifty-four realistic multi-database agent questions spanning 12 datasets, nine domains, and four DBMSes.
54 个跨 12 数据集、9 领域、4 DBMS 的真实多数据库 agent 问题。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Real enterprise data questions often span heterogeneous databases, contain inconsistent key formats, require extracting fields from free text, and depend on domain knowledge. Existing Text-to-SQL and table-QA benchmarks evaluate single databases, single queries, or small in-context tables and do not cover full workflows of discovery, joining, cleaning, computation, and explanation.

The Data Agent Benchmark (DAB) uses multi-database tasks derived from enterprise workloads and executable validate.py scripts to evaluate whether agents can complete end-to-end analysis from natural-language goals and return correct results.

真实企业数据问题往往跨多个异构数据库，键值格式不一致，还需要从自由文本中抽取字段并结合领域知识。现有 Text-to-SQL 或表格问答只评测单库、单查询或上下文内小表，无法覆盖数据发现、连接、清洗、计算和解释的完整 agent 工作流。

Data Agent Benchmark（DAB）用真实企业负载抽象出的多数据库任务和可执行 validate.py，评估 agent 能否从自然语言目标出发完成端到端数据分析并给出正确结果。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DAB contains 54 questions across 12 datasets, nine domains, and four database-management systems, including combinations of SQLite, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, and MongoDB. Tasks stress multi-database integration, ill-formatted key joins, unstructured-text transformation, and domain knowledge. Each item provides database environments, a question, ground truth, and validation scripts. The data object is a multi-source state–agent queries/code–answer artifact–programmatic result record, forming a small but realistic benchmark.

DAB 含 54 个问题、12 个数据集、9 个领域和 4 类数据库管理系统，覆盖 SQLite、PostgreSQL、DuckDB 与 MongoDB 等组合。任务体现多库集成、格式不规范的 key join、非结构化文本转换和领域知识四类难点。每题提供数据库环境、问题、ground truth 与验证脚本；数据对象是“多源数据状态—agent 查询/代码—答案产物—程序验证结果”，定位为小规模高真实性 benchmark。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Study workloads: A formative study across six industries identifies common enterprise data-agent goals and failure modes.
  1. Build multi-database data: Each domain receives multiple databases and tables, deliberately preserving cross-source key mismatches, text fields, and heterogeneous DBMSes.
  1. Write realistic questions: Tasks require source discovery, query or code generation, joining, and transformation rather than one SQL statement.
  1. Create validators: Ground truth and validate.py scripts compare structured answers, numbers, or sets automatically instead of relying on an LLM judge.
  1. Execute uniformly: Agents access databases in containers; queries, code, and intermediate artifacts are logged, with pass@1 and failure categories reported.

1. 调研工作负载： 作者通过六个行业的形成性研究归纳企业数据 agent 的常见目标与失败点。
  1. 构建多库数据： 为每个领域准备多个数据库与表，故意保留跨库引用差异、文本字段和异构 DBMS。
  1. 编写真实问题： 问题要求 agent 发现数据源、生成查询或代码、进行连接与转换，而非只输出一条 SQL。
  1. 建立验证器： 每题保存 ground truth 和 validate.py，对结构化答案、数值或集合进行自动比较，避免由 LLM judge 决定。
  1. 统一执行： agent 在容器中访问数据库，日志记录查询、代码和中间产物，最终以 pass@1 和错误类型汇总。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates five frontier LLMs, with the strongest, Gemini-3-Pro, reaching only 38% pass@1. This shows that complete data workflows remain difficult even when individual database operations are mature. Runnable databases and validators distinguish errors in source choice, joins, text transformation, and answer formatting. The evidence supports realism and difficulty, but 54 questions yield wide confidence intervals, and later public-leaderboard results should not be conflated with paper baselines.

论文评测五个 frontier LLM，最佳 Gemini-3-Pro 的 pass@1 仅为 38%，说明即使单项数据库操作已较成熟，完整数据 workflow 仍困难。任务均附可运行数据库和验证脚本，错误分析能区分数据源选择、join、文本转换及答案格式问题。该证据支持 benchmark 的现实难度，但 54 题导致置信区间较宽，且当前公开 leaderboard 的后续结果不应与论文基线混为一谈。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing benchmarks commonly reduce data questions to mapping a schema to SQL. DAB exposes agents to multiple DBMSes, dirty keys, text transformation, and domain context, with task-level validation scripts defining correctness. It evaluates a data-engineering-plus-analysis loop rather than SQL syntax or execution equivalence alone. The novelty is the workload and environment construction, not a new data agent.
既有 benchmark 通常把数据问题缩减为 schema 与 SQL 的映射。DAB 的变化是让 agent 直接面对多 DBMS、脏 key、文本转换和领域上下文，并将正确性落实为任务级验证脚本。它评估的是“数据工程 + 分析”闭环，而不是单纯 SQL syntax 或执行等价性；新意在工作负载和环境构造，不是新的 data agent。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Sample size: Fifty-four questions cannot reliably distinguish small model differences. Results need bootstrap intervals and restrained domain-level slicing.
  1. Data rights: Source datasets may have different terms. Training reuse requires per-dataset licence review rather than relying only on the benchmark repository licence.
  1. Answer contract: validate.py checks expected outputs but may miss unnecessary access or privacy risks. Real deployments also need query permissions and audit logs.

1. 样本量： 54 个问题不足以稳定比较细小模型差异，结果应报告 bootstrap 区间并避免过度按领域切分。
  1. 数据授权： 多源数据可能有不同使用条件；复用训练前需逐数据集核对许可，而非只看 benchmark 仓库许可。
  1. 答案契约： validate.py 只检查预期输出，可能漏掉不必要的数据访问或隐私风险；真实部署还需查询权限与审计日志。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Data-agent evaluation: Compare agents on fixed Docker and database snapshots, reporting pass@1, attempts, and errors by joins, text, and domain knowledge.
  1. Tool-planning training: Convert successful logs into source-discovery–query–transformation–validation trajectories for SFT, while retaining the original 54 questions for testing.
  1. Enterprise transfer: Turn anonymized internal database questions into the same task structure with deterministic validators, using least privilege and masking for sensitive fields.

1. 数据 agent 评测： 在固定 Docker 和数据库快照上比较 agent，报告 pass@1、试次数和按 join/文本/领域知识分类的错误。
  1. 工具规划训练： 将成功日志转为数据源发现—查询—转换—验证轨迹，用于 SFT；原始 54 题应保留为测试。
  1. 企业迁移： 用相同结构把内部匿名数据库问题转成任务，并为答案写确定性 validator；敏感字段需最小权限和脱敏。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: Fifty-four realistic multi-database agent questions spanning 12 datasets, nine domains, and four DBMSes.
  1. Method hook: Tasks require complete data workflows and are scored by per-item validate.py scripts rather than judges.
  1. Data hook: Databases, questions, ground truth, validators, and an execution-log framework are released.
  1. Evidence anchor: The best of five frontier models reaches only 38% pass@1.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits enterprise data-agent diagnosis after source-licence review and permission auditing.

1. 一句话定位： 54 个跨 12 数据集、9 领域、4 DBMS 的真实多数据库 agent 问题。
  1. 方法抓手： 问题要求完整数据 workflow，最终由每题 validate.py 而非 judge 判分。
  1. 数据抓手： 发布数据库、问题、ground truth、验证脚本和执行日志框架。
  1. 证据锚点： 五个 frontier 模型中最佳 pass@1 仅 38%。
  1. 复用决定： 适合企业数据 agent 诊断；复用前核对源数据许可并补充权限审计。
